name: decision-map
description: Plan work too big for one agent session as a map of decision tickets kept in your repo as markdown (docs/decision-map/): chart the map, then resolve one decision per session until the way is clear. Two backends ship: local markdown under docs/decision-map/, and GitHub Issues using native sub-issues and blocked-by dependencies (ADR 0062). Azure DevOps is still gated on its half of the marker-survival probe (ADR 0059). `lint` is the runnable check on a map's own health. Adapts the wayfinder idea to this marketplace's plugins and safety gates.
